name: stairFlight
note: One straight flight. dims are DERIVED from the params, not from the composite's own [w,h,d]: height = steps * rise, depth = steps * run, width = width. Treads ascend toward +Z. The flight is a single manifold `stepStack` prim (see prims.js: geom.js stepStack merges N shells and V1 rejects it), so this composite has one sub-part; the stringers the reference drawing shows are deferred.
